# UBC Unlimited — Merchant Services Utah

> UBC Unlimited is a Utah-based merchant services company providing payment processing, POS systems, and credit card processing solutions to businesses across Utah. Led by Josh Cornia, UBC Unlimited offers local support, competitive rates, and fast onboarding for businesses of all sizes and risk profiles.

## About

UBC Unlimited helps Utah businesses reduce credit card processing fees, implement modern POS systems, and access merchant services tailored to their industry. We serve businesses in all 29 Utah counties, from Salt Lake City to rural communities.

- Phone: (801) 462-0923
- Address: Salt Lake City, Utah
- [Website](https://www.ubcunlimited.com)
- [Request a Consultation](https://www.ubcunlimited.com/consultation)
- [Free Statement Review](https://www.ubcunlimited.com/statement-review)

## Core Services

- Credit card processing (interchange-plus pricing)
- ACH & eCheck processing
- POS systems (SkyTab, Clover)
- eCommerce payment gateways
- Mobile processing
- Virtual terminals
- Invoicing & recurring billing
- Gift cards & loyalty programs
- Cash discount & dual pricing programs
- High-risk merchant accounts
- Check guarantee

## Service Area

Utah statewide, including Salt Lake City, Provo, Orem, Lehi, Ogden, St. George, and all 29 Utah counties.

## Industries Served

Retail, restaurants, healthcare, automotive, eCommerce, salons & spas, property management, non-profit, high-risk industries (firearms, CBD/hemp, nutraceuticals, online pharmacy, subscription/continuity, travel, online gaming, telemarketing, credit repair, vape, adult entertainment, cryptocurrency).
